name: Security Forces
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Flying Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Flying. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Furious Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Surge Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Surge when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Ballistic Vest
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Ballistic Vest, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Ballistic Vest (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Ballistic Vest
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Piercing Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Smash
specialRules.description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Ballistic Vest Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Ballistic Vest. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Fortified
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Fortified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Fortified (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Flying
specialRules.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of terrain it doesn't end its move it. This unit automatically passes jumping rolls.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Melee Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -2" range to a min. of 6" when charging it.

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
